qualifier: iron and heme uptake alongside copper, manganese, zinc and cadmium handling
name: Metal ion and heme transport and homeostasis
rationale: All members concern membrane transport, buffering or homeostasis of transition/heavy metal ions or heme, and unlike the zinc-centred confusables (C1, C2) and the metal-response confusable (C3) the theme carries iron/transferrin and heme uptake, while unlike C4 it spans copper, manganese, zinc and cadmium transport.

qualifier: early HIV-1 entry, uncoating and reverse transcription
name: APOBEC cytidine deamination and early HIV-1 infection steps
rationale: Members combine APOBEC-type cytidine deamination/editing and host restriction of viral replication with early HIV-1 steps (entry, uncoating, minus/plus-strand DNA synthesis), the early HIV steps separating it from C1/C3 and the deamination restriction from the integration-focused C2/C4.

qualifier: BH3-only PUMA and NOXA activation
name: p53-dependent apoptosis via BH3-only PUMA and NOXA
rationale: All members describe TP53 transcriptional induction of apoptosis genes and the BH3-only (PUMA/NOXA) inactivation of BCL-2 leading to cytochrome c release, which separates it from C2 (BAX/BAK without TP53 transcription) and C1/C3/C4 (intrinsic apoptosis regulation without the BH3-only step).

qualifier: amino acids, oligopeptides and urate
name: Epithelial amino acid, oligopeptide and urate transport
rationale: Members are plasma membrane SLC carriers and their renal/epithelial transport disorders for amino acids, di/oligopeptides, urate and organic anions, distinguished from C1/C4 (organic cation/anion only), C2 (hexose absorption) and C3 (cationic amino acids such as lysine, arginine, ornithine).

qualifier: termination and R-loop resolution
name: RNA polymerase II transcription control including termination and R-loops
rationale: Members regulate Pol II transcription from preinitiation complex assembly through elongation to termination (with transcription-linked BTM modules), and termination, R-loop processing and chromatin-localization members distinguish it from the elongation-complex C1 and the broad RNA processing C4.

qualifier: K63 deubiquitination and SUMOylation
name: NF-kappaB control by K63 deubiquitination and SUMOylation
rationale: All members concern regulation of NF-kappaB/transcription factor activity through ubiquitin and SUMO modification, and the NF-kappaB and SUMO members separate it from the DUB-family confusables (C1, C3, C4) while K63 deubiquitination separates it from the TNFR1/linear-ubiquitin C2.

qualifier: misfolded protein quality control and ERAD
name: Atypical ubiquitin chains in misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members cover E3-mediated K6/K11/K27/K29, branched and free ubiquitin chain formation together with protein unfolding, quality control and ERAD, the quality-control members separating it from C1/C3/C4 and the atypical chain types from C2.

core: Hepatic glucuronidation and organic anion transport
qualifier: bilirubin and drug conjugation and excretion
name: Bilirubin and drug glucuronidation with hepatic organic anion transport
rationale: Members concern UDP-glucuronate conjugation and OATP/MRP2 transport of bilirubin, heme breakdown products and drugs, with bilirubin/heme members separating it from C1/C3 and glucuronidation/drug ADME members separating it from C2/C4.

qualifier: killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
name: Antimicrobial killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: All members describe host killing or restriction of microbes (antifungal humoral response, Gram-positive defense, cytolysis, metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity), with direct killing/cytotoxicity distinguishing it from mucosal agglutination (C1/C2), respiratory burst (C3) and degranulation (C4).

core: Nuclear receptor control of metabolic genes
qualifier: LXR regulation of lipid and glucose metabolism
name: LXR nuclear receptor control of lipid and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor transcription and its SUMOylation with LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) targets in lipogenesis, lipolysis, gluconeogenesis and VLDL remodeling, which separates it from the PPAR/circadian (C1), adipogenesis (C2, C3) and lipid droplet (C4) confusables.

qualifier: C-type lectin receptors, IL-1-family and Th17 cytokines
name: Antifungal C-type lectin, IL-1-family and Th17 cytokine immunity
rationale: Members link fungal recognition by Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN to IL-18/IL-36/IL-37/IL-38 and IL-17/Th17 cytokine responses, the IL-1-family and IL-17 members separating it from C1/C4 and the lectin/fungal members from C2 (IL-33) and C3 (IL-10/IL-12 family).

qualifier: with endopeptidase activity regulation
name: Hypersensitivity effector responses with endopeptidase regulation
rationale: Members are antigen-driven hypersensitivity (type II, type IV, acute inflammatory) and antibody-dependent cytotoxicity plus positive/negative endopeptidase regulation, the latter and type IV hypersensitivity distinguishing it from the Fc receptor (C1, C2), neutrophil (C3) and complement (C4) confusables; the endopeptidase members are only loosely tied to the immune core.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
name: GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
rationale: All members concern GPCR/forskolin-driven cAMP production and PKA activation (and its inhibition of calcium-dependent exocytosis), separating it from the adenylate cyclase-to-CREB confusables (C1, C2, C4) and the Gi inhibitory C3.

qualifier: MTF1-driven metallothionein induction
name: Cellular response to metal ions and metallothionein induction
rationale: Members are responses to mercury, lead, manganese, iron, zinc, cobalt, copper and selenium ions with MTF1/metallothionein induction, distinguished from cadmium transport (C1, C3), heme oxygenase/oxidative control (C2) and aryl hydrocarbon xenobiotic response (C4).

qualifier: memory B cells and B cell homeostasis
name: Germinal center reaction and memory B cell homeostasis
rationale: Members cover Tfh/ICOS help, germinal center formation and B cell differentiation, memory B cell signatures and restraint of B cell proliferation/apoptosis, distinguished from the plasma cell/generic B cell confusables (C1, C2, C4) by germinal center and homeostasis members and from C3 by memory B cell signatures.

qualifier: ribbon assembly/disassembly and membrane tubulation
name: Golgi ribbon assembly, disassembly and membrane tubulation
rationale: All members concern Golgi structure and positioning (ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, stack reorganization) and membrane tubulation/budding, separating it from Golgi protein retention (C1, C2), COPI traffic (C3) and general trafficking (C4).

qualifier: telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking
name: Telomerase assembly, Cajal body trafficking and telomere extension
rationale: Members describe telomerase RNA folding, holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body localization and recruitment to telomeres for extension, separating it from telomere protection/C-strand synthesis confusables (C2, C3, C4) and senescence (C1).

qualifier: memory and plasma cell fates via germinal centers
name: B cell differentiation into memory and plasma cells
rationale: Members cover B cell development, Tfh/ICOS-driven germinal center differentiation, memory B cells and plasma cell/immunoglobulin signatures, plasma cell and germinal center members distinguishing it from the B cell proliferation/BCR confusables (C1, C3, C4) and generic B cell modules (C2).

qualifier: activating and inhibitory receptor control
name: Receptor-mediated activation and inhibition of NK cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members concern NK (and T cell) cytotoxicity, cytokine production and activation under positive and negative receptor control including MHC class Ib recognition, distinguished from granzyme/KIR/tolerance confusables (C1-C3) and T cell activation C4.

qualifier: complement cascade
name: Complement and antimicrobial innate defense against microbial pathogens
rationale: Members span complement activation and regulation, defensins and neutrophil granule antimicrobials, and bacterial subversion of host defenses, with the complement members distinguishing it from its nearest confusable C4 and the antimicrobial/pathogen members from C1-C3.

qualifier: coupled to DNA replication and repair, with ADP-ribosylation control
name: Replication- and repair-coupled nucleosome remodeling and ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members concern chromatin assembly/disassembly and remodeling during DNA replication and repair together with ADP-ribosylation regulation, separating it from CENP-A deposition (C1), histone acetylation (C4) and DSB-localization/PARylation sets (C2, C3).

qualifier: COPI retrograde transport under Rab/ARF GTPase control
name: Rab- and ARF-controlled COPI Golgi traffic and organization
rationale: Members cover COPI anterograde/retrograde and intra-Golgi vesicle traffic, vesicle tethering, Golgi organization and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation including Rab geranylgeranylation, separating it from TGN-endosome-lysosome and COPII confusables (C1-C3) and the GTPase-signalling C4.

core: Dendritic cell chemokine and cytokine production
qualifier: CCL5 regulation and cGAS-STING activation
name: Dendritic cell CCL5 and cytokine production with cGAS-STING activation
rationale: Members regulate CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine/chemokine production and cGAS-STING activation, the cGAS-STING members separating it from macrophage chemokine (C3) and DC/Th1 (C4) confusables and the chemokine members from C1 (cGAS/IFN-beta) and C2 (TLR7/8/9).

qualifier: break sensing and NHEJ versus HR pathway choice
name: Double-strand break sensing and NHEJ versus HR choice
rationale: All members concern sensing of DSBs and classical/alternative NHEJ and positive/negative regulation of homologous recombination, distinct from BRCA-defect (C1), chromatin/ADP-ribosylation (C2, C3) and resection/MMEJ/SSA (C4) confusables.

qualifier: retinol uptake and retinoic acid synthesis
name: Retinoid metabolism from retinol uptake to retinoic acid
rationale: Members describe vitamin A (retinol, retinal, retinoic acid) metabolism and transport, including STRA6-mediated uptake and retinoid disease events that separate it from C1-C3, and retinoic acid biosynthesis that separates it from the visual cycle C4.
